title: Tokyo, Tuesday October 6: a morning walk to the Imperial Palace
lead: An easy walk from your hotel to the Imperial Palace before we meet at 9:00. Hibiya Park, then the old palace gate and the open plaza, and back the same way.
subject: Oct 6
pick: Walk as far as you like and turn back whenever you want.
hero_alt: Sakuradamon Gate of the Imperial Palace
hero_cap: Sakuradamon Gate, one of the old palace gates.

workshop.h2: Good to know before you go
workshop.lead: The Outer Gardens of the palace are an open public area, so you can walk there at any hour. The East Gardens, where you pay a visit inside, open at 9:00, so we do not go in this morning.
facts: The Outer Gardens and the plaza in front of Nijubashi are open to walk through. The East Gardens open at 9:00 (closed Mondays and Fridays), so they are not part of this walk.
Early October mornings in Tokyo are cool, about 18 to 20 degrees. A light jacket is enough.
Hibiya Park has public toilets. Take a break there if you like.
steps: Stop whenever you like and turn back. The walk is a suggestion.
Open the Google Maps link in the plan to see the route. It works on foot.
Plan to be back in the lobby by about 8:50, so you can sit for a few minutes before 9:00.
workshop.note: If you feel tired, it is perfectly fine to skip the walk and have a slow breakfast. We start at 9:00 either way.
photos: Nijubashi bridge, a bit further on

meet_h2: Meet Yuuki in the hotel lobby, 9:00
meet_text: Yuuki meets you in the lobby of your hotel at 9:00.
meet_addr: THE BLOSSOM HIBIYA, Shimbashi 1-1-13, Minato-ku, Tokyo
meet_place: THE BLOSSOM HIBIYA Shimbashi 1-1-13 Minato-ku Tokyo
meet_hint: If you are running late, message Yuuki on WhatsApp. No problem at all.
